name: Output Width
desc: Output width in pixels presented to the display/host compositor.

name: Output Height
desc: Output height in pixels presented to the display/host compositor.

name: Game Width
desc: Render width presented to the game itself; gamescope up/downscales from this to the output resolution.

name: Game Height
desc: Render height presented to the game itself.

name: Game Refresh Rate
desc: Game refresh rate in frames per second.

name: Unfocused Refresh Rate
desc: Game refresh rate to use only while the gamescope window is unfocused (nested mode). Lets you drop clocks/power when alt-tabbed.

name: Max Scale
desc: Maximum scale factor gamescope will apply.

name: Force Windows Fullscreen
desc: Force windows inside gamescope to always be the size of the nested display (fullscreen).

name: Cursor Scale Height
desc: Base output height to linearly scale the cursor image against.

name: Force Orientation
desc: Rotate the internal display.

name: Scaler
desc: Upscaler type. 'integer' restricts scaling to integer multiples only (best for pixel-art with the pixel/nearest filter).

name: Upscale Filter
desc: Upscaler filter. fsr = AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0. nis = NVIDIA Image Scaling v1.0.3.

name: Sharpness
desc: Upscaler sharpness, 0 (max) to 20 (min). Alias: --fsr-sharpness.

name: HDR Enabled
desc: Enable HDR output. Needs the Gamescope WSI layer enabled on the client side for HDR clients to be supported.

name: SDR Gamut Wideness
desc: Wideness of the gamut for SDR content, 0-1.

name: SDR Content Nits
desc: Luminance of SDR content in nits. Default: 400.

name: Inverse Tonemap SDR->HDR
desc: Enable SDR->HDR inverse tone mapping. Only affects SDR input.

name: ITM Input Nits
desc: Luminance of SDR content used as input for inverse tone mapping. Default 100, max 1000.

name: ITM Target Nits
desc: Target luminance of the inverse tone mapping process. Default 1000, max 10000.

name: Frame-rate Limit
desc: Simple frame-rate limit, used as a divisor of the refresh rate (rounds down): 60/59->60fps, 60/25->30fps. 0 = disabled.

name: Adaptive Sync (VRR)
desc: Enable adaptive sync / VRR if the display and driver support it.

name: Immediate Flips
desc: Allow immediate (tearing) flips instead of FIFO presentation - trades a compositor frame of latency for possible tear lines.

name: Realtime Scheduling
desc: Use realtime scheduling for gamescope's own threads.

name: Mouse Sensitivity
desc: Multiply mouse movement by the given decimal factor.

name: Force Grab Cursor
desc: Always use relative mouse mode instead of flipping depending on cursor visibility.

name: Hide Cursor Delay
desc: Hide the cursor image after this many milliseconds of inactivity.

name: Cursor Image
desc: Path to a default cursor image.

name: Grab Keyboard (nested)
desc: Grab the keyboard (nested mode only).

name: Default Touch Mode
desc: 0: hover, 1: left, 2: right, 3: middle, 4: passthrough.

name: Steam Integration
desc: Enable Steam integration.

name: XWayland Count
desc: Create N XWayland servers (2 lets overlay windows run isolated from the game's own XWayland instance - see STEAM_MULTIPLE_XWAYLANDS in the env-var list above).

name: Expose Wayland (xdg-shell)
desc: Support Wayland clients using xdg-shell.

name: Backend
desc: Rendering backend. auto autodetects (default).

name: Prefer VK Device
desc: Prefer this Vulkan device for compositing.

name: Prefer Output (embedded)
desc: List of connectors in order of preference (embedded mode only).

name: Display Index (nested)
desc: Force a specific display index in nested mode.

name: Generate DRM Mode
desc: DRM mode generation algorithm (embedded mode).

name: Virtual Connector Strategy
desc: Specifies how virtual connectors are created.

name: Ready FD
desc: Notify this FD when gamescope is ready.

name: Stats Path
desc: Write statistics to this path.

name: Allow Deferred Backend
desc: Allow initting the backend in a deferred way if it doesn't work immediately (minor correctness trade-off with modifiers etc).

name: Keep Alive
desc: Keep gamescope alive even after the primary process has died.

name: Fullscreen (nested)
desc: Make the nested window fullscreen.

name: Borderless (nested)
desc: Make the nested window borderless.

name: ReShade Effect
desc: Name of a ReShade shader to use, looked up in /usr/share/gamescope/reshade/Shaders or ~/.local/share/gamescope/reshade/Shaders. Requires a gamescope build with ReShade support compiled in.

name: ReShade Technique Index
desc: Technique index to use from the selected ReShade effect.

name: Mura Map
desc: Path to the mura compensation map to use for the display (Steam Deck panel calibration).

name: Disable Hardware Planes
desc: Disable libliftoff (hardware plane) usage - forces full compositing. Useful to rule out plane-assignment issues.

name: Debug Layers
desc: Debug libliftoff plane assignment.

name: Debug Focus
desc: Debug XWM focus handling.

name: Synchronous X11
desc: Force synchronous X11 connection (slower, deterministic ordering for debugging).

name: Debug HUD
desc: Paint a HUD with gamescope's own debug info.

name: Debug Events
desc: Log X11 events.

name: Force Composition
desc: Disable direct scan-out; always composite through gamescope's Vulkan renderer. Useful to isolate whether an artifact comes from the direct-scanout path or the compositor itself.

name: Composite Debug
desc: Draw frame markers on alternating screen corners while compositing.

name: Disable Color Management
desc: Disable gamescope's color management pipeline.

name: Disable XRes
desc: Disable XRes-based PID lookup.

name: Force HDR Support
desc: Force HDR support even if the display doesn't advertise it. HDR clients are still tone-mapped to SDR output in that case.

name: Force HDR Output
desc: Force HDR10 PQ output even if the display doesn't support it - looks very wrong if the display genuinely can't do it.

name: HDR Debug Heatmap
desc: Display a heatmap-style debug view of HDR luminance across the scene.

name: MangoApp Overlay
desc: Launch with the mangoapp (MangoHud) performance overlay. gamescope's recommended way to get MangoHud: use this instead of MANGOHUD=1 on the game or on gamescope itself (avoids double overlays and the extra present hook on the game's swapchain). Don't combine with the 'MangoHud' prefix toggle in this builder — that runs a second MangoHud instance on the game.

name: Mouse Sensitivity
desc: Multiply mouse movement by the given decimal number (e.g. 0.5, 1.25). Useful when the game renders at a lower -w/-h than the output.

name: Cursor Hotspot
desc: Hotspot of the default cursor image set with --cursor, as x,y.

name: Force Touch Pointer Emulation
desc: Force XWayland to emulate pointer events from touch input.

name: Fade-out Duration
desc: Duration in ms of the fade-out when switching between windows/apps.

name: Force Composition Rotation
desc: Always rotate the output in the compositor instead of at scanout (autodetected otherwise). Costs a composite pass every frame.
